Botanique at Bartley

Botanique at BartleyBotanique at Bartley is a large residential development located in the bustling new town that is Serangoon in District 19. Its 797 units are split over nine 17 storey blocks which are deliberately separated as much as possible to alleviate the problem of them overlooking one another. Units range from 1, 2 and 3 bed configurations, with residents having the ability to alter the layouts to suit their needs and tastes. Botanique at Bartley is located just 3-minute walk from Bartley MRT Station on the Circle Line giving access to the CBD in under half an hour. It is also very conveniently placed in terms of expressways and drivers can reach the CBD or Orchard in around 15 minutes.The developer for Botanique at Bartley is UOL Group Limited (UOL), a listed property firm with an extensive portfolio of investment and development properties including residential apartments, offices, retail malls, hotels, spas and restaurants. It also owns and/or manages over 30 hotels, resorts and serviced apartments in Asia, Oceania and North America.Botanique at Bartley – Unique Selling PointsThe location of Botanique at Bartley is a major factor in its popularity. It is on the city fringes, a 15-minute drive from the CBD and Orchard. It is also just a 3-minute walk to its nearest MRT station – Bartley, on the Circle Line. Botanique at Bartley itself is a well-designed development, boasting Smeg appliances. It also gives owners the ability to change the layout of the units to suit their own needs and tastes.Botanique at Bartley – AccessibilityThe nearest MRT to Botanique at Bartley is Bartley MRT Station on the Circle Line which is a 3-minute walk.
